caption: An arbitrary n-qubit unitary is reduced to two-qubit and single-qubit gates, then to the finite Clifford+T set; the final circuit is within the chosen ε.

spec.title: Approximating any unitary
spec.aria: A downward flowchart showing an arbitrary unitary decomposed into two-qubit gates, then single-qubit gates, then H and T with CNOT, with final error at most epsilon.
